outs.note: The show said Williams is probably out for the entire season. He has not played since Oct. 25.
Chet Holmgren is out eight to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear and will not need surgery. He has not played since Oct. 25.
The show said Jaylin Williams is questionable for Oklahoma City against Atlanta. He has missed four straight games with low back spasms.
The show said Wallace is presumably out for the season. He has not played since Oct. 25.

RJ Barrett was moved from questionable to out for tonight on the NBA's 06:00 PM injury report. He had averaged 36 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.

Scottie Barnes is out Wednesday against Washington with a groin injury. He has started every game he played and averaged 36 minutes over his last five, so Toronto has to fill a starting spot and a lot of frontcourt minutes.
Kawhi Leonard (left knee swelling) is out at least another week and has not played since October 23. Toronto plans an update next week and he could be on a minutes limit when cleared.
The show said Evan Mobley is out again on Wednesday. He has not appeared in the box scores since 11/11.

Jaylon Tyson was moved from doubtful to out for tonight on the NBA's 01:45 PM injury report. He had averaged 25 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.

Peyton Watson was moved from doubtful to out for tonight (low back contusion) on the NBA's 06:15 PM injury report. He had averaged 26 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.

Dean Wade was moved from questionable to out for tonight on the NBA's 06:15 PM injury report. He had averaged 28 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.

Jaylen Brown is out for Philadelphia tonight at Orlando with a left hamstring strain. The show said his absence should reshape Philly and open up more opportunities for Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, LeBron James and Joel Embiid. The show also called it a pace-down spot because Orlando plays slowly.
The show said CJ McCollum will be out for about a month for Atlanta, and he is ruled out tonight with a left calf strain. Kingston Flemings is also out for the Hawks.

Kingston Flemings (lumbar strain) is out Wednesday at Oklahoma City, his second straight absence, though he practiced Tuesday. With CJ McCollum also out, Atlanta's ball handling falls to Dyson Daniels, Jalen Johnson and RayJ Dennis.
Asa Newell had surgery Tuesday to repair a plantar plate tear in his left big toe, hurt November 4. He will be re-evaluated in about four months.

Andrew Nembhard was moved from questionable to out for tonight on the NBA's 05:30 PM injury report. He had averaged 34 minutes over his last 5 games, so those minutes go to teammates; the injury page lists who gains.
The show said Tyrese Haliburton could be back as early as the end of next week, but that later in November is more realistic. The show said there have been no reported setbacks in his recovery.
